hpe_dom_children_root.brief: 取得节点子内容的容器 / Obtain the container holding a node's children
hpe_dom_children_root.return: `<template>` 返回其内容片段，其余节点返回自身 / The content fragment for `<template>`, otherwise the node itself
hpe_dom_children_root.details: `<template>` 的子节点存放在分离的 DocumentFragment 中（规范里的 `content`），解析器、`innerHTML` 与 `textContent` 都经此函数读写。| A `<template>`'s children live in a detached DocumentFragment (the spec's `content`); the parser, `innerHTML` and `textContent` all read and write through this function.
hpe_dom_children_root.note: 传入 `NULL` 返回 `NULL`；首次访问 `<template>` 时按需创建 content 片段 / A `NULL` input yields `NULL`; the content fragment is created lazily on first access

hpe_dom_element.brief: 创建一个元素节点 / Create an element node

params.tag: 标签名（`NULL` 视为 `div`）/ Tag name, `NULL` falls back to `div`

hpe_dom_element.return: 新的元素节点 / The new element node

hpe_dom_text.brief: 创建一个文本节点 / Create a text node

params.text: 文本内容（`NULL` 视为空串）/ Text content, `NULL` falls back to the empty string

hpe_dom_text.return: 新的文本节点 / The new text node

hpe_dom_document.brief: 创建一个文档节点 / Create a document node
hpe_dom_document.return: 新的文档节点 / The new document node

hpe_dom_fragment.brief: 创建一个文档片段节点 / Create a document-fragment node
hpe_dom_fragment.return: 新的片段节点 / The new fragment node
hpe_dom_fragment.note: 片段本身不属于树；把它追加到父节点时会搬移其子节点 / The fragment itself is not part of the tree; appending it moves its children instead

hpe_dom_append.brief: 把子节点追加到父节点末尾 / Append a child node to the end of a parent

params.child: 待插入的子节点；若为文档片段则按序搬移其所有子节点并释放空片段 / Child to insert; a DocumentFragment has its children moved in order and is then freed

hpe_dom_append.note: 先解除子节点与原父节点的关联；插入成功后报告一次子节点列表变更 / The child is detached from any previous parent first, and a child-list mutation is reported on success
hpe_dom_append.warning: `parent` 与 `child` 任一为 `NULL` 时直接返回 / Returns immediately when either `parent` or `child` is `NULL`

hpe_dom_detach.brief: 把节点从其父节点上摘下 / Detach a node from its parent
hpe_dom_detach.note: 只更新兄弟链与父指针，不释放节点；未挂载的节点直接返回 / Only the sibling links and parent pointer are updated, the node is not freed; an unattached node returns unchanged

hpe_dom_insert_before.brief: 在参照节点之前插入子节点 / Insert a child before a reference node

params.child: 待插入的子节点；若为文档片段则按序搬移其所有子节点并释放空片段 / Child to insert; a DocumentFragment has its children moved in order and is then freed
params.ref: 参照节点；为 `NULL` 或不是 `parent` 的子节点时改为追加 / Reference node; a `NULL` value or one that is not a child of `parent` falls back to appending

hpe_dom_insert_before.note: 先解除 `child` 与原父节点的关联；`child == ref` 时不做任何事 / `child` is detached first; when `child == ref` nothing is done
hpe_dom_insert_before.warning: `parent` 或 `child` 为 `NULL` 时直接返回 / Returns immediately when `parent` or `child` is `NULL`

hpe_dom_replace_child.brief: 用一个节点替换另一个子节点 / Replace one child node with another

params.new_child: 新节点；为 `NULL` 时仅移除旧节点 / Replacement node; `NULL` removes the old child only
params.old_child: 被替换的子节点，必须是 `parent` 的子节点 / Child being replaced, must be a child of `parent`

hpe_dom_replace_child.return: 被摘下的旧节点（调用方接管）或 `NULL` / The detached old node owned by the caller, or `NULL`
hpe_dom_replace_child.note: 返回值可能是 `old_child` 自身；`new_child == old_child` 时原样返回 / The returned node may be `old_child` itself; when `new_child == old_child` it is returned unchanged

hpe_dom_clone.brief: 克隆一个节点（可深度克隆）/ Clone a node, optionally deeply

params.node: 被克隆的节点，可为 `NULL` / Node to clone, may be `NULL`

hpe_dom_clone.details: 元素克隆会复制标签与全部属性；文本、文档、片段按其类型重建。| An element clone keeps its tag and every attribute; text, document and fragment nodes are rebuilt according to their type.
hpe_dom_clone.note: `deep` 非 0 时递归克隆整个子树；浅拷贝的副本没有父节点、兄弟或子节点 / A non-zero `deep` recursively clones the whole subtree; a shallow copy has no parent, siblings or children
hpe_dom_clone.return: 新的克隆节点，输入为 `NULL` 时返回 `NULL` / The new clone, or `NULL` when the input was `NULL`

hpe_dom_attr.brief: 读取元素上的属性值 / Read an attribute value from an element

params.name: 属性名，大小写不敏感 / Attribute name, matched case-insensitively

hpe_dom_attr.return: 属性值（内部存储，调用方不得释放）或 `NULL` / The attribute value as internal storage that must not be freed, or `NULL`
hpe_dom_attr.note: 无该属性或参数为 `NULL` 时返回 `NULL` / Returns `NULL` when the attribute is absent or a parameter is `NULL`

hpe_dom_set_attr.brief: 设置元素上的属性 / Set an attribute on an element

params.value: 属性值（`NULL` 视为空串）/ Attribute value, `NULL` falls back to the empty string

hpe_dom_set_attr.note: 属性已存在时覆盖其值，否则新增；两种情况都会报告一次属性变更 / An existing attribute is overwritten, otherwise a new one is appended; both cases report an attribute mutation
hpe_dom_set_attr.warning: `node` 或 `name` 为 `NULL` 时直接返回 / Returns immediately when `node` or `name` is `NULL`

hpe_dom_remove_attr.brief: 移除元素上的属性 / Remove an attribute from an element

params.name: 属性名，大小写不敏感 / Attribute name, matched case-insensitively

hpe_dom_remove_attr.note: 属性不存在时不做任何事；成功移除后报告一次属性变更 / A no-op when the attribute is absent; a successful removal reports an attribute mutation
hpe_dom_remove_attr.warning: `node` 或 `name` 为 `NULL` 时直接返回 / Returns immediately when `node` or `name` is `NULL`

hpe_dom_prev_sibling.brief: 取得节点的前一个兄弟节点 / Obtain the preceding sibling of a node
hpe_dom_prev_sibling.return: 父节点下紧邻的前一个兄弟，无则 `NULL` / The immediately preceding sibling, or `NULL`
hpe_dom_prev_sibling.note: 无父节点或是首个子节点时返回 `NULL` / Returns `NULL` when the node has no parent or is the first child

hpe_dom_find_tag.brief: 按文档顺序查找首个指定标签的元素 / Find the first element with the given tag in document order

params.root: 查找起点（自身不计入），可为 `NULL` / Search root, itself excluded; may be `NULL`
params.tag: 标签名，大小写不敏感 / Tag name, matched case-insensitively

hpe_dom_find_tag.return: 命中的元素或 `NULL` / The matching element, or `NULL`
hpe_dom_find_tag.note: 递归深度优先，只比较元素节点 / Recurses depth-first and only compares element nodes

hpe_dom_is_element.brief: 判断节点是否为元素 / Test whether a node is an element
hpe_dom_is_element.return: 元素节点返回 1 / 1 when the node is an element
hpe_dom_is_element.note: `node` 为 `NULL` 时返回 0 / Returns 0 for a `NULL` node

hpe_dom_free.brief: 递归释放节点及其整个子树 / Recursively free a node and its whole subtree
hpe_dom_free.note: 同时释放 `<template>` 的 content 片段、全部属性与标签/文本字符串；传 `NULL` 安全无操作 / Also frees a `<template>`'s content fragment, every attribute and the tag/text strings; a `NULL` input is a safe no-op

hpe_dom_add_mutation_sink.brief: 追加一个 DOM 变更订阅者 / Append a DOM mutation sink

params.fn: 变更回调（`NULL` 时直接返回）/ Mutation callback, a `NULL` value returns immediately
params.ud: 透传给 `fn` 的用户数据，与 `fn` 一起构成订阅标识 / User data forwarded to `fn`, paired with `fn` to identify the sink

hpe_dom_add_mutation_sink.details: 订阅者按安装顺序保存在固定大小的表内（最多 `HPE_MAX_MUT_SINKS` 个）。| Sinks are kept in an ordered fixed-size table of at most `HPE_MAX_MUT_SINKS` entries.
hpe_dom_add_mutation_sink.note: 同一 `(fn, ud)` 组合已存在时不再重复安装；表满时静默忽略 / A duplicate `(fn, ud)` pair is ignored, and a full table is silently left unchanged

hpe_dom_remove_mutation_sink.brief: 移除一个已安装的 DOM 变更订阅者 / Remove an installed DOM mutation sink

params.fn: 要移除的变更回调 / Mutation callback to remove
params.ud: 与之配对的用户数据 / The user data paired with it

hpe_dom_remove_mutation_sink.note: 按 `(fn, ud)` 精确匹配，未找到时不做任何事；后续订阅者前移保持顺序 / Matches on `(fn, ud)` exactly; when absent nothing happens and later sinks shift up to preserve order

hpe_dom_clear_mutation_sinks.brief: 移除全部变更订阅者 / Remove every mutation sink
hpe_dom_clear_mutation_sinks.details: 文档销毁时调用，使 `notify_sinks` 之后不再回调任何人。| Called when the document is torn down so that `notify_sinks` no longer reaches anyone.
